posts.title: What Should Importers Check in a Plastic Water Bottle Dimension and Tolerance Sheet Before Bulk Ordering?
posts.description: A practical B2B guide to checking bottle height, diameter, neck, base, capacity, tolerance notes and sample control before a wholesale order.
posts.intro: A dimension sheet is useful only when the buyer can connect every measurement to the exact bottle, cap, capacity and production version being quoted.
posts.coverAlt: Wholesale buyer measuring a clear plastic water bottle with a caliper beside a blank dimension sheet in a warehouse

sections.heading: Start with the exact product identity
sections.paragraph: Before comparing numbers, freeze the identity of the product the numbers describe. Record the model or SKU, body version, cap version, capacity in millilitres and the reviewed ounce size class, material stated by the supplier, color, decoration and revision date. A dimension sheet for a 500 ml body cannot automatically approve a 750 ml body that uses the same marketing family name. Ask the supplier to show which drawing, mold or sample the sheet belongs to and keep a photo of that sample with the RFQ. If the supplier has both a standard and a custom version, write the difference in the purchase file instead of relying on a filename. This prevents a buyer from comparing a precise drawing with an approximate catalogue image or accepting a replacement part that happens to look similar but has a different neck or base.

sections.heading: Check the measurements that affect fit
sections.paragraph: Review overall height, maximum body diameter, base diameter, neck outside diameter, opening, cap height and any handle, grip ring or sleeve that changes the envelope. Ask whether each number is measured on the bottle body alone or on the assembled product. For a retail shelf, carton, bicycle cage or vehicle holder, the widest point and usable height matter more than a nominal capacity label. For a refill point or dispenser, the neck and opening may matter more than the shoulder. Mark the critical dimensions on the drawing and compare them with the physical sample using the same reference points. If a number is absent, do not invent a tolerance; ask the factory to identify the measurement method, tool and acceptance range used for production inspection.

sections.heading: Separate capacity from physical volume claims
sections.paragraph: Capacity should be written as the factory-confirmed millilitre value, with an approximate or size-class ounce expression when the page is written for overseas buyers. Do not turn an ounce class into an exact conversion or use a rounded capacity to approve a different body. Ask how capacity was measured, whether it is brimful or usable fill, and whether the cap, straw or internal insert changes the usable amount. For a mixed wholesale assortment, create one row per model and record ml, ounce class, height, diameter and cap combination. This gives a retailer a defensible way to compare shelf space and user expectations while keeping the technical source value intact. If the supplier cannot confirm the capacity definition, label the item as requiring confirmation instead of presenting a precise figure the drawing does not support.

sections.heading: Read tolerance notes instead of only nominal sizes
sections.paragraph: A nominal height or diameter does not tell the buyer how much variation may appear between samples. Look for the drawing's measurement points, reference datums, rounding rules and tolerance notes. Ask which dimensions are critical to fit, sealing, decoration or packaging and which are informational. A cap may seal even when a cosmetic diameter varies slightly, while a small neck or thread change can create a leak or prevent a spare lid from fitting. The buyer does not need to create a factory standard from a blog article; the buyer does need a written method for deciding whether a sample is within the supplier's stated control. Save the approved drawing and marked sample, then require a new review if the mold, resin, cap, process or decoration changes.

sections.heading: Compare the sheet with a production-intent sample
sections.paragraph: Use a sample that represents the version being quoted, not a presentation piece selected only for photography. Measure the same points on the agreed sample set and note whether the bottle is empty, dry, assembled and at room temperature. Do not use a visual match as proof of dimension accuracy. Record tool resolution, operator, date and sample identity in the inspection note, while leaving the supplier responsible for its own controlled production method. If the buyer needs a formal capability study, request it separately with the method and population defined. For ordinary wholesale approval, a clear side-by-side record exposes a changed base, taller cap, thicker sleeve or different handle before cartons are printed and the order is released.

sections.heading: Control drawings, artwork and packaging together
sections.paragraph: Dimension changes often create downstream problems outside the bottle itself. A taller cap can change the inner carton height; a wider base can change the master-carton count; a sleeve can hide a measurement point; and a logo area can move when the shoulder or taper changes. Add the approved drawing revision, artwork proof, color or material note and packaging specification to one purchase-order package. Ask the supplier to identify the owner of each file and the change that would trigger a resample. The goal is not to freeze every cosmetic decision forever; it is to make sure a commercial update cannot silently become an engineering change. This also makes future reorders simpler because the distributor can compare a new sample against the same controlled record instead of a vague product name.

sections.heading: Turn the sheet into an acceptance rule
sections.paragraph: The final RFQ or purchase order should state the exact model, ml capacity, approximate or class ounce reference, material as confirmed, cap, color, decoration, key dimensions, supplier tolerance notes, sample reference and change-approval rule. State which dimensions are checked at incoming inspection and which documents must accompany a revision. Do not promise a tolerance, MOQ, delivery time or certification unless the supplier has provided and the buyer has approved that fact. Keep an approved sample, the drawing and inspection photos together. When a later batch is received, compare the exact variant and record any deviation before distributing stock. A dimension sheet becomes useful when it helps two different people make the same decision; it is not useful when it is only a decorative PDF attached to an RFQ.

checklist: Record the exact body, cap, material, color, capacity and drawing revision.
Write both the confirmed millilitre value and the approximate ounce size class.
Mark height, widest diameter, base, neck, opening, cap and accessory dimensions.
Ask how each dimension is measured and which tolerance notes control acceptance.
Compare the sheet with a production-intent sample using the same reference points.
Record tool, operator, date, sample identity and inspection condition.
Link drawing, artwork, color, decoration and packing revision in the RFQ.
Define which dimensions affect fit, sealing, decoration or carton planning.
Require review when mold, resin, cap, decoration or packing changes.
Attach the approved drawing and sample record to the wholesale order.
faqs: Does a catalogue photo prove the bottle dimensions?
No. Use the exact production-intent sample, marked reference points and the supplier's measurement method.
Should capacity be treated as an exact ounce conversion?
No. Keep the confirmed ml value and use an approximate or size-class ounce expression for overseas buyers.
Can the same tolerance sheet approve another bottle in the range?
No. Confirm the exact body, cap, mold, material, revision and accessory combination before approval.
What should happen after a mold or cap change?
Pause the reorder and compare a new sample with the drawing, artwork, packing and acceptance record.

es.title: ¿Qué deben revisar los importadores en una hoja de dimensiones y tolerancias de botellas plásticas antes de comprar al por mayor?
es.description: Guía B2B para revisar altura, diámetro, cuello, base, capacidad, tolerancias y muestras antes de un pedido mayorista.
es.intro: Una hoja dimensional solo sirve cuando cada medida corresponde a la botella, tapa, capacidad y revisión que se cotizan.

sections.heading: Comience por la identidad exacta
sections.paragraph: Registre SKU, cuerpo, tapa, ml, clase aproximada de oz, material, color y revisión. Un nombre comercial no aprueba otra capacidad.

sections.heading: Revise las medidas que afectan el encaje
sections.paragraph: Marque altura, diámetro, base, cuello, abertura, tapa, asa y funda. Pregunte si cada cifra pertenece al conjunto ensamblado.

sections.heading: Separe capacidad y volumen físico
sections.paragraph: Use el valor confirmado en ml y una clase aproximada de oz. Aclare volumen útil o a rebosar y no trate la clase como igualdad exacta.

sections.heading: Lea las notas de tolerancia
sections.paragraph: Pida puntos de medición, referencias y rangos de aceptación. Un cambio pequeño en cuello o rosca puede afectar tapa y repuesto.

sections.heading: Compare el dibujo con una muestra de producción
sections.paragraph: Mida una muestra real en los mismos puntos y registre herramienta, fecha y condición. Una foto de catálogo no prueba la dimensión.

sections.heading: Controle dibujo, arte y embalaje juntos
sections.paragraph: Una tapa más alta o una base más ancha puede cambiar caja, cantidad y decoración. Mantenga una revisión común del pedido.

sections.heading: Convierta la hoja en aceptación
sections.paragraph: Incluya modelo, ml, oz aproximadas, material confirmado, medidas críticas, muestra y regla de cambios en la orden.

checklist: Identifique el SKU y la hoja dimensional.
Registre ml y clase aproximada de oz.
Anote material, tapa, color y revisión.
Compare la hoja dimensional con una muestra real.
Use una condición de inspección repetible.
Pida método y evidencia cuando falte un dato.
Separe una observación de una certificación.
Conserve fotos, documentos y muestra aprobada.
Exija revisión tras un cambio de componente.
Incluya el criterio en la orden de compra.
faqs: ¿Basta revisar la hoja dimensional en una foto?
No. Use una muestra física y una condición repetible.
¿La capacidad confirma todas las medidas?
No. Confirme ml, cuerpo, tapa y puntos de medición por SKU.
¿Puedo publicar una afirmación amplia?
Solo si la fuente cubre exactamente el producto, uso y mercado.
¿Qué hago si cambia el proveedor?
Pause la reposición y vuelva a revisar la configuración y los documentos.

pt.intro: A ficha só é útil quando cada medida corresponde à garrafa, tampa, capacidade e revisão cotadas.

sections.heading: Comece pela identidade exata
sections.paragraph: Registre SKU, corpo, tampa, ml, classe aproximada de oz, material, cor e revisão. Nome comercial não aprova outro corpo.

sections.heading: Confira as medidas de encaixe
sections.paragraph: Marque altura, maior diâmetro, base, gargalo, abertura, tampa, alça e sleeve. Pergunte se a medida é do conjunto.

sections.heading: Separe capacidade e volume físico
sections.paragraph: Use o ml confirmado e uma classe aproximada de oz. Esclareça volume útil ou cheio até a borda.

sections.heading: Leia as notas de tolerância
sections.paragraph: Peça pontos de medição, referências e faixa de aceitação. Mudança no gargalo pode alterar tampa e vedação.

sections.heading: Compare desenho e amostra de produção
sections.paragraph: Meça a amostra real nos mesmos pontos e registre ferramenta, data e condição. Foto não comprova dimensão.

sections.heading: Controle desenho, arte e embalagem juntos
sections.paragraph: Tampa mais alta ou base mais larga pode mudar caixa, quantidade e impressão. Use revisão comum.

sections.heading: Transforme a ficha em aceitação
sections.paragraph: Inclua modelo, ml, oz aproximada, material, dimensões críticas, amostra e regra de alteração na ordem.

A capacidade confirma todas as medidas?
Não. Confirme ml, corpo, tampa e pontos por SKU.
Posso publicar uma alegação ampla?
Somente se a fonte cobrir produto, uso e mercado exatos.
O que fazer se o fornecedor mudar?
Pause a reposição e revise configuração e documentos.

ru.title: Что импортёрам проверить в листе размеров и допусков пластиковой бутылки перед оптовым заказом?
ru.description: B2B-руководство по проверке высоты, диаметра, горлышка, основания, объёма, допусков и образца до закупки.
ru.intro: Лист размеров полезен, когда каждая цифра относится к точной бутылке, крышке, объёму и версии поставки.

sections.heading: Начните с точной идентификации
sections.paragraph: Запишите SKU, корпус, крышку, мл, приблизительный oz, материал, цвет и ревизию. Название семейства не подтверждает другой корпус.

sections.heading: Проверьте размеры посадки
sections.paragraph: Отметьте высоту, диаметр, основание, горлышко, отверстие, крышку, ручку и чехол. Уточните размер сборки.

sections.heading: Отделите объём от физического размера
sections.paragraph: Используйте подтверждённые мл и приблизительный класс oz. Уточните полезный или полный объём.

sections.heading: Читайте примечания о допусках
sections.paragraph: Запросите точки измерения, базы и диапазон приёмки. Изменение горлышка влияет на крышку и уплотнение.

sections.heading: Сравните чертёж с образцом
sections.paragraph: Измерьте реальный образец в тех же точках и запишите инструмент, дату и состояние. Фото не доказывает размер.

sections.heading: Свяжите чертёж, дизайн и упаковку
sections.paragraph: Более высокая крышка или широкое основание меняют короб, количество и нанесение. Нужна общая ревизия.

sections.heading: Превратите лист в условие приёмки
sections.paragraph: Укажите модель, мл, приблизительный oz, материал, размеры, образец и правило изменений в заказе.

checklist: Идентифицируйте SKU и лист размеров.
Запишите мл и приблизительный класс oz.
Укажите материал, крышку, цвет и версию.
Сравните лист размеров с реальным образцом.
Используйте повторяемое условие проверки.
Запросите метод и доказательства при отсутствии данных.
Отделяйте наблюдение от сертификата.
Храните фото, документы и утверждённый образец.
Проверяйте после изменения компонента.
Внесите критерий в заказ.
faqs: Достаточно ли фото лист размеров?
Нет. Нужны физический образец и повторяемое условие.
Подтверждает ли объём все размеры?
Нет. Проверьте мл, корпус, крышку и точки по SKU.
Можно ли публиковать широкое заявление?

posts.title: Can Recycled Plastic Water Bottles Be Used for Food Contact? A Wholesale Buyer Checklist
posts.description: What B2B buyers should ask about recycled plastic source control, recycling process, food-contact evidence, testing and destination-market claims.
posts.intro: Recycled plastic is not a complete compliance answer. A wholesale buyer needs the polymer, feedstock, process, intended use and market evidence before using a food-contact or sustainability claim.
posts.coverAlt: Wholesale buyer reviewing clear plastic bottles, resin samples and a blank material document at a sourcing table

sections.heading: Do not start with the green claim
sections.paragraph: Begin by separating the commercial phrase from the technical question. Recycled content, post-consumer recycled, reprocessed and recyclable can describe different things, and none of them by itself proves that a bottle is suitable for direct food contact. Write the intended use, beverage or food type, temperature, contact duration, repeated-use expectation and destination market in the buyer brief. Then ask which component the claim covers: bottle body, cap, seal, straw, sleeve or packaging. A clear bottle made from one resin with a cap made from another is a multi-component product. Do not let a sustainability phrase replace a material identity, a source-control explanation or the documents required for the market where the finished product will be sold.

sections.heading: Identify polymer and recycled feedstock
sections.paragraph: Ask the supplier to state the exact polymer family for each food-contact component and whether the input is virgin resin, post-industrial regrind, post-consumer recycled material or a controlled closed-loop stream. Record the source, collection method and whether recycled material is used in the bottle body, a non-contact layer or a separate accessory. Do not infer a polymer from transparency, color or the sound of the bottle. Ask whether colorant, additive, adhesive, printing ink and gasket are included in the same declaration. If the supplier can only say eco plastic, keep the item in a material-clarification state and do not publish a food-contact or recycled-content claim until the exact construction is documented.

sections.heading: Request process and source-control evidence
sections.paragraph: For recycled plastic intended for food contact, the recycling process and input controls matter as much as the name of the polymer. Ask how feedstock is collected, sorted, protected from contamination and processed, and who owns the process documentation. Request the relevant declaration, process description, test reports or regulatory opinion that the supplier can share for the exact material and use. Do not treat a generic resin certificate, a factory logo or a laboratory-looking page as proof of a finished bottle. FDA guidance discusses process information, contamination control and proposed conditions of use; European rules also address recycled food-contact plastic and quality control. Connect the evidence to the actual bottle component and destination market.

sections.heading: Separate food contact from general product safety
sections.paragraph: A bottle can have a material claim relevant to food contact and still require separate checks for closure, gasket, ink, adhesive, odor, migration, temperature and repeated-use conditions. Ask whether supplied evidence covers the complete assembled product or only the resin. Check cap and seal separately when the liquid contacts them, and confirm that a sleeve or decoration does not change the intended contact surface. Do not promise that a recycled bottle is safe for every drink, temperature or cleaning method. Describe the reviewed scope and tell the buyer what remains to be confirmed. This answers a real procurement question instead of turning a partial document into a broad marketing guarantee.

sections.heading: Match evidence to the destination market
sections.paragraph: The same material may face different documentation and labeling expectations in the United States, the European Union or another destination. Record the market, importer of record, intended food contact, temperature and use duration before asking for a compliance package. For the EU, recycled plastic food-contact rules include requirements around recycling processes and quality control; for the US, FDA evaluates recycled plastic processes and proposed conditions of use. These references are not a certificate for a specific XUYI model. They are a reason to request the correct supplier evidence and, where necessary, obtain specialist regulatory review. Never solve a market question by copying a claim from another language page or another product family.

sections.heading: Use precise language on the product page
sections.paragraph: Commercial copy should distinguish made with recycled content, recyclable after use, recycled plastic available for inquiry, and food-contact documentation supplied for the reviewed configuration. Use the narrowest phrase that source evidence supports. If the supplier has not confirmed the percentage, do not publish a percentage. If evidence covers resin but not cap or decoration, say so. If the buyer needs an exact recycled-content or compliance statement, make it a document request in the RFQ and hold the public claim until review is complete. This is more useful for searchers because it answers what they must verify instead of repeating a vague sustainability adjective.

sections.heading: Put the document package into the RFQ
sections.paragraph: The RFQ should name the exact SKU, body and cap materials, capacity in ml and approximate ounce class, color, recycled-content question, intended beverage, temperature, contact duration, destination market, packaging and artwork. Ask for source-control description, process evidence, applicable declaration, test scope, revision date and change-notification rule. State that a resin, cap, seal or decoration change requires a new review. Keep the approved sample and document set together so a later reorder cannot use an old statement for a new construction. The buyer does not need to promise a certification that has not been issued; the buyer needs a traceable question, a controlled answer and clear limits on public wording.

checklist: State the exact polymer for the body, cap, seal and any liquid-contact layer.
Separate recycled content, recyclable design, post-consumer feedstock and regrind.
Record beverage, temperature, contact time, reuse pattern and destination market.
Ask for source-control and recycling-process evidence for the stated construction.
Check whether documents cover the assembled bottle rather than resin only.
Review cap, gasket, ink, adhesive, odor, migration and cleaning conditions.
Match the evidence to the United States, EU or other destination requirements.
Do not publish a recycled percentage or food-contact claim without a source.
Add revision dates and a change-notification rule to the RFQ document set.
Hold the public claim until the exact SKU and evidence scope are approved.
faqs: Does recycled plastic automatically mean food-contact suitable?
No. Confirm the polymer, feedstock, recycling process, complete assembly, intended use and destination-market evidence.
Is a resin certificate enough for a finished bottle?
Not by itself. The buyer must check the cap, seal, decoration and the conditions covered by the evidence.
Can a buyer publish a recycled percentage from a supplier's general claim?
Only when the percentage and exact construction are documented for the SKU being sold. Otherwise keep the wording narrow.
What is the safest next step for a new market?
State the destination, use and temperature in the RFQ, then request the matching document package before making a public claim.

sections.heading: No empiece por la promesa verde
sections.paragraph: Separe reciclado, posconsumo, reprocesado y reciclable. Escriba bebida, temperatura, duración, reutilización y mercado.

sections.heading: Identifique polímero y materia prima
sections.paragraph: Solicite el polímero y el origen de cuerpo, tapa y junta. No deduzca el material por transparencia o color.

sections.heading: Solicite proceso y control de origen

sections.heading: Separe contacto alimentario y seguridad
sections.paragraph: Revise tapa, junta, tinta, adhesivo, olor, migración y temperatura. Aclare si la evidencia cubre el conjunto.

sections.heading: Adapte documentos al mercado
sections.paragraph: Registre país, importador, bebida y contacto. Los requisitos de EE. UU. y la UE deben revisarse por separado.

sections.heading: Use lenguaje preciso
sections.paragraph: Diferencie contenido reciclado, reciclable y documentación disponible. No publique porcentaje o certificación sin fuente.

sections.heading: Ponga el paquete en la RFQ
sections.paragraph: Incluya SKU, ml, oz, material, uso, mercado, documentos, revisión y regla para cambios en la RFQ.

Anote material, tapa, color y revisión.

Solo si la fuente cubre exactamente el producto, uso y mercado.

sections.paragraph: Separe reciclado, pós-consumo, reprocessado e reciclável. Registre bebida, temperatura, duração, reuso e mercado.

sections.heading: Separe contato com alimento e segurança

sections.heading: Combine os documentos ao mercado

sections.heading: Use linguagem precisa
sections.paragraph: Diferencie conteúdo reciclado, reciclável e documentação disponível. Não publique percentual sem fonte.

sections.heading: Coloque o pacote na RFQ

posts.title: How Should Wholesale Buyers Check Clear Plastic Water Bottle Quality Before a Bulk Order?
posts.description: A B2B inspection guide for clear plastic bottle transparency, haze, scratches, molding marks, cap fit, decoration and protective packing.
posts.intro: Clear bottles expose defects that a dark color can hide. A buyer needs a repeatable sample and lighting check for clarity, marks, seams, cap fit and packing before approving a wholesale production run.
posts.coverAlt: Quality inspector holding a clear plastic water bottle up to daylight beside cartons and sample bottles

sections.heading: Define what clear quality means for the channel
sections.paragraph: Clear can mean transparent enough to see the liquid, optically uniform for a retail shelf, or simply free from obvious cosmetic defects. Ask the buyer and supplier to define expected appearance before sampling. Record the body material as confirmed, capacity in millilitres and ounce size class, cap and decoration, intended price point and display context. A promotional bottle viewed at arm's length may have a different acceptance level from a premium transparent bottle sold beside technical goods. Do not promise optical clarity or zero defects without an agreed inspection method. The first useful step is a visual standard a second inspector can understand without relying on the word clear alone.

sections.heading: Inspect transparency and haze under consistent light
sections.paragraph: Use the same background, light direction and viewing distance for every sample. Look through the bottle body and across the shoulder, base and seam rather than checking only the front panel. Record haze, uneven wall appearance, bubbles, inclusions, color cast and areas that look different when empty or filled. A phone photograph can support the record but cannot replace an agreed visual comparison because reflections and exposure change the result. Keep the approved sample in the same lighting reference for a reorder. If the buyer wants a numeric transparency or haze limit, ask the supplier for the method and instrument rather than converting a casual visual impression into an invented specification.

sections.heading: Separate molding marks from transport damage
sections.paragraph: Check the bottle before and after normal handling. Look for scratches, scuffs, sink marks, weld or parting lines, flash, black specks, trapped particles and deformation around the base and neck. Mark whether a mark is part of molding, caused by the cap or decoration, or introduced by packing and carton movement. A clear bottle can show small defects more easily, but the response should still be tied to the buyer's appearance standard and selling channel. Photograph the location, retain the sample and record the inspection condition. This lets the factory correct a mold or packing issue instead of receiving a vague complaint that the whole batch looks bad.

sections.heading: Check the cap, neck and base as a complete set
sections.paragraph: A transparent body does not pass inspection if the cap is misaligned, the gasket is visible in the wrong position or the base rocks on a shelf. Assemble the exact cap and body, close it with the approved method, and inspect neck finish, thread start, sealing surface, cap height and bottom contact. Fill the sample only under the agreed test condition; do not claim leakproof performance from appearance. If the bottle will be packed with a sleeve, label or handle, inspect the assembled envelope because the accessory may hide a mark or create pressure on the wall. Link the clear-body decision to the complete SKU and not to an unassembled sample. Keep the final decision tied to the written sample standard.

sections.heading: Review decoration and color consistency
sections.paragraph: Transparent plastic can make printing, film, gradient color and logo edges look different from a solid-color body. Compare artwork position, registration, opacity, edge sharpness and color under the agreed light. Confirm whether the buyer wants the liquid or fill line to remain visible and whether decoration must leave a clear area for capacity or care information. Avoid claiming Pantone accuracy, scratch resistance or permanent adhesion unless the supplier has supplied the relevant evidence. Keep one decorated sample and one undecorated reference when useful. A clear bottle quality check is about the final sellable assembly, so a good body with a misregistered logo still requires correction before the bulk order.

sections.heading: Protect the appearance through packing
sections.paragraph: A clear bottle can leave the factory in good condition and arrive with rubbing, dust or cap marks if packing allows parts to contact each other. Ask how bottles are separated, whether caps are protected, whether sleeves are used, and what the master carton does to prevent movement during the route. Check a packed sample, not only a loose bottle, and record the carton orientation and inner protection used for the approved variant. Do not invent a carton quantity or transport test result; ask the supplier to confirm the actual packing plan and, when needed, add a sample shipment or handling check to the purchase process. Keep the packaging record linked to the same clear-body SKU and artwork revision.

sections.heading: Create a visual standard for reorders
sections.paragraph: Release the bulk order only after the buyer has a clear sample, inspection conditions, defect examples, cap and decoration approval, and a rule for changes. Identify model, capacity in ml, ounce size class, material, transparency expectation, cap, logo, packing and approving team. At receiving, compare the actual variant with that record before distributing cartons. If resin, mold, cap, sleeve, ink or packing changes, reopen visual review instead of assuming the product name protects appearance. This gives a distributor a repeatable way to detect a meaningful change before customers see it without promising perfection that the source evidence does not support.

checklist: Define whether clear means liquid visibility, shelf uniformity or a defect limit.
Record the exact SKU, material, ml capacity, ounce size class, cap and decoration.
Use the same background, light direction, distance and sample condition.
Check haze, bubbles, inclusions, color cast, seam, base and shoulder consistency.
Separate molding marks, handling scratches and packing damage in the record.
Assemble the approved body, cap, seal, sleeve and decoration before judging the SKU.
Compare printing, transparent zones, logo edges and capacity information with artwork.
Inspect a packed sample for rubbing, dust, cap marks and movement in the carton.
Keep the approved sample, photos, defect examples and inspection conditions.
Reopen visual approval after resin, mold, cap, ink or packing changes.
faqs: Is a clear bottle that looks good empty automatically acceptable?
No. Check the exact assembly, fill condition, cap, decoration, packing and agreed visual standard.
Can a phone photo define a haze or scratch limit?
It can support a record, but acceptance should use consistent light, distance, sample condition and an approved reference.
Does a clean body prove the cap will not leak?
No. Leak and closure checks require the exact body, cap, seal and agreed test condition.
What should be rechecked on a repeat order?
Recheck the approved variant, visual defects, artwork, cap, packing and any resin, mold or process change.

sections.heading: Define what clear quality means for the channel
sections.paragraph: Clear can mean transparent enough to see the liquid, optically uniform for a retail shelf, or simply free from obvious cosmetic defects. Ask the buyer and supplier to define expected appearance before sampling. Record the body material as confirmed, capacity in millilitres and ounce size class, cap and decoration, intended price point and display context. A promotional bottle viewed at arm's length may have a different acceptance level from a premium transparent bottle sold beside technical goods. Do not promise optical clarity or zero defects without an agreed inspection method. The first useful step is a visual standard a second inspector can understand without relying on the word clear alone.

sections.heading: Inspect transparency and haze under consistent light
sections.paragraph: Use the same background, light direction and viewing distance for every sample. Look through the bottle body and across the shoulder, base and seam rather than checking only the front panel. Record haze, uneven wall appearance, bubbles, inclusions, color cast and areas that look different when empty or filled. A phone photograph can support the record but cannot replace an agreed visual comparison because reflections and exposure change the result. Keep the approved sample in the same lighting reference for a reorder. If the buyer wants a numeric transparency or haze limit, ask the supplier for the method and instrument rather than converting a casual visual impression into an invented specification.

sections.heading: Separate molding marks from transport damage
sections.paragraph: Check the bottle before and after normal handling. Look for scratches, scuffs, sink marks, weld or parting lines, flash, black specks, trapped particles and deformation around the base and neck. Mark whether a mark is part of molding, caused by the cap or decoration, or introduced by packing and carton movement. A clear bottle can show small defects more easily, but the response should still be tied to the buyer's appearance standard and selling channel. Photograph the location, retain the sample and record the inspection condition. This lets the factory correct a mold or packing issue instead of receiving a vague complaint that the whole batch looks bad.

sections.heading: Check the cap, neck and base as a complete set
sections.paragraph: A transparent body does not pass inspection if the cap is misaligned, the gasket is visible in the wrong position or the base rocks on a shelf. Assemble the exact cap and body, close it with the approved method, and inspect neck finish, thread start, sealing surface, cap height and bottom contact. Fill the sample only under the agreed test condition; do not claim leakproof performance from appearance. If the bottle will be packed with a sleeve, label or handle, inspect the assembled envelope because the accessory may hide a mark or create pressure on the wall. Link the clear-body decision to the complete SKU and not to an unassembled sample. Keep the final decision tied to the written sample standard.

sections.heading: Review decoration and color consistency
sections.paragraph: Transparent plastic can make printing, film, gradient color and logo edges look different from a solid-color body. Compare artwork position, registration, opacity, edge sharpness and color under the agreed light. Confirm whether the buyer wants the liquid or fill line to remain visible and whether decoration must leave a clear area for capacity or care information. Avoid claiming Pantone accuracy, scratch resistance or permanent adhesion unless the supplier has supplied the relevant evidence. Keep one decorated sample and one undecorated reference when useful. A clear bottle quality check is about the final sellable assembly, so a good body with a misregistered logo still requires correction before the bulk order.

sections.heading: Protect the appearance through packing
sections.paragraph: A clear bottle can leave the factory in good condition and arrive with rubbing, dust or cap marks if packing allows parts to contact each other. Ask how bottles are separated, whether caps are protected, whether sleeves are used, and what the master carton does to prevent movement during the route. Check a packed sample, not only a loose bottle, and record the carton orientation and inner protection used for the approved variant. Do not invent a carton quantity or transport test result; ask the supplier to confirm the actual packing plan and, when needed, add a sample shipment or handling check to the purchase process. Keep the packaging record linked to the same clear-body SKU and artwork revision.

sections.heading: Create a visual standard for reorders
sections.paragraph: Release the bulk order only after the buyer has a clear sample, inspection conditions, defect examples, cap and decoration approval, and a rule for changes. Identify model, capacity in ml, ounce size class, material, transparency expectation, cap, logo, packing and approving team. At receiving, compare the actual variant with that record before distributing cartons. If resin, mold, cap, sleeve, ink or packing changes, reopen visual review instead of assuming the product name protects appearance. This gives a distributor a repeatable way to detect a meaningful change before customers see it without promising perfection that the source evidence does not support.

checklist: Define whether clear means liquid visibility, shelf uniformity or a defect limit.
Record the exact SKU, material, ml capacity, ounce size class, cap and decoration.
Use the same background, light direction, distance and sample condition.
Check haze, bubbles, inclusions, color cast, seam, base and shoulder consistency.
Separate molding marks, handling scratches and packing damage in the record.
Assemble the approved body, cap, seal, sleeve and decoration before judging the SKU.
Compare printing, transparent zones, logo edges and capacity information with artwork.
Inspect a packed sample for rubbing, dust, cap marks and movement in the carton.
Keep the approved sample, photos, defect examples and inspection conditions.
Reopen visual approval after resin, mold, cap, ink or packing changes.
faqs: Is a clear bottle that looks good empty automatically acceptable?
No. Check the exact assembly, fill condition, cap, decoration, packing and agreed visual standard.
Can a phone photo define a haze or scratch limit?
It can support a record, but acceptance should use consistent light, distance, sample condition and an approved reference.
Does a clean body prove the cap will not leak?
No. Leak and closure checks require the exact body, cap, seal and agreed test condition.
What should be rechecked on a repeat order?
Recheck the approved variant, visual defects, artwork, cap, packing and any resin, mold or process change.

es.title: ¿Cómo deben revisar los compradores mayoristas la calidad de una botella plástica transparente antes de un pedido?
es.description: Guía B2B para revisar transparencia, velo, rayas, marcas de moldeo, tapa, decoración y embalaje protector.
es.intro: Las botellas transparentes muestran defectos que un color oscuro puede ocultar. El comprador necesita una revisión repetible.

sections.heading: Defina qué significa transparente
sections.paragraph: Aclare si busca ver el líquido, uniformidad en estantería o ausencia de defectos. Registre SKU, material, ml, oz, tapa y decoración.

sections.heading: Revise transparencia con luz constante
sections.paragraph: Use el mismo fondo, dirección y distancia. Observe cuerpo, hombro, base, velo, burbujas, inclusiones y tono.

sections.heading: Separe moldeo y daño de transporte
sections.paragraph: Busque rayas, rebabas, líneas, puntos y deformación antes y después de manipular. Fotografie ubicación y condición.

sections.heading: Compruebe tapa, cuello y base juntos
sections.paragraph: Monte el SKU exacto y revise rosca, junta, altura de tapa, base y estabilidad. La apariencia no demuestra ausencia de fugas.

sections.heading: Revise impresión y consistencia
sections.paragraph: Compare registro, borde, opacidad, zona transparente y datos con el arte aprobado. No prometa resistencia sin evidencia.

sections.heading: Proteja el aspecto en el embalaje
sections.paragraph: Compruebe separadores, polvo, roce, tapa y movimiento en caja. Revise una muestra embalada.

sections.heading: Cree un estándar para reposición
sections.paragraph: Guarde muestra, luz, defectos, tapa, decoración y embalaje. Un cambio de resina, molde o tinta exige revisión.

checklist: Identifique el SKU y la muestra transparente.
Registre ml y clase aproximada de oz.
Anote material, tapa, color y revisión.
Compare la muestra transparente con una muestra real.
Use una condición de inspección repetible.
Pida método y evidencia cuando falte un dato.
Separe una observación de una certificación.
Conserve fotos, documentos y muestra aprobada.
Exija revisión tras un cambio de componente.
Incluya el criterio en la orden de compra.
faqs: ¿Basta revisar la muestra transparente en una foto?
No. Use una muestra física y una condición repetible.
¿La capacidad confirma todas las medidas?
No. Confirme ml, cuerpo, tapa y puntos de medición por SKU.
¿Puedo publicar una afirmación amplia?
Solo si la fuente cubre exactamente el producto, uso y mercado.
¿Qué hago si cambia el proveedor?
Pause la reposición y vuelva a revisar la configuración y los documentos.

sections.heading: Defina o que é transparência
sections.paragraph: Esclareça se busca ver o líquido, uniformidade na prateleira ou ausência de defeitos. Registre SKU, material, ml, oz e arte.

sections.heading: Confira com luz constante

sections.heading: Separe moldagem e dano de transporte
sections.paragraph: Procure riscos, rebarbas, linhas, pontos e deformação antes e depois. Fotografe local e condição.

sections.heading: Verifique tampa, gargalo e base juntos
sections.paragraph: Monte o SKU exato e confira rosca, vedação, altura da tampa, base e estabilidade. Aparência não prova ausência de vazamento.

sections.heading: Revise impressão e consistência
sections.paragraph: Compare registro, borda, opacidade, área transparente e dados com a arte aprovada. Não prometa resistência sem evidência.

sections.heading: Proteja a aparência na embalagem
sections.paragraph: Confira separadores, poeira, atrito, tampa e movimento na caixa. Avalie amostra embalada.

sections.heading: Crie padrão para reposições
sections.paragraph: Guarde amostra, luz, defeitos, tampa, decoração e embalagem. Mudança de resina, molde ou tinta exige revisão.

Posso publicar uma alegação ampla?
Somente se a fonte cobrir produto, uso e mercado exatos.

ru.title: Как оптовому покупателю проверить качество прозрачной пластиковой бутылки до крупного заказа?
ru.description: B2B-руководство по прозрачности, мутности, царапинам, следам формования, крышке, нанесению и упаковке.
ru.intro: Прозрачная бутылка показывает дефекты, которые скрывает тёмный цвет. Нужна повторяемая проверка внешнего вида и упаковки.

sections.heading: Определите прозрачное качество
sections.paragraph: Уточните, нужно ли видеть жидкость, получить единый вид на полке или исключить заметные дефекты. Запишите SKU и материал.

sections.heading: Проверяйте при одном свете
sections.paragraph: Используйте одинаковые фон, свет и расстояние. Осмотрите корпус, плечо, основание, мутность, пузыри и включения.

sections.heading: Отделите формование от перевозки
sections.paragraph: Ищите царапины, облой, линии, точки и деформацию до и после обращения. Фиксируйте место и состояние.

sections.heading: Проверьте крышку, горлышко и основание
sections.paragraph: Соберите точный SKU и проверьте резьбу, уплотнение, высоту крышки, основание и устойчивость. Вид не доказывает герметичность.

sections.heading: Проверьте нанесение
sections.paragraph: Сравните край, прозрачную зону и данные с утверждённым макетом. Не обещайте стойкость без доказательств.

sections.heading: Защитите вид упаковкой
sections.paragraph: Проверьте разделители, пыль, трение, крышку и движение в коробе. Смотрите упакованный образец.

sections.heading: Создайте стандарт повторного заказа
sections.paragraph: Храните образец, свет, дефекты, крышку, дизайн и упаковку. Смена смолы или формы требует новой проверки.

checklist: Идентифицируйте SKU и прозрачный образец.
Запишите мл и приблизительный класс oz.
Укажите материал, крышку, цвет и версию.
Сравните прозрачный образец с реальным образцом.
Используйте повторяемое условие проверки.
Запросите метод и доказательства при отсутствии данных.
Отделяйте наблюдение от сертификата.
Храните фото, документы и утверждённый образец.
Проверяйте после изменения компонента.
Внесите критерий в заказ.
faqs: Достаточно ли фото прозрачный образец?
Нет. Нужны физический образец и повторяемое условие.
Подтверждает ли объём все размеры?
Нет. Проверьте мл, корпус, крышку и точки по SKU.
Можно ли публиковать широкое заявление?
Только если источник покрывает точный продукт, применение и рынок.
Что делать при смене поставщика?
Остановить повторный заказ и проверить конфигурацию и документы.

tr.description: Şeffaflık, pus, çizik, kalıp izi, kapak, baskı ve koruyucu ambalajı kontrol eden pratik B2B rehber.
tr.intro: Şeffaf şişeler koyu rengin gizleyebildiği kusurları gösterir. Alıcı görünüm, montaj ve ambalaj için tekrar edilebilir kontrol yapmalıdır.

sections.heading: Şeffaf kalitenin anlamını tanımlayın
sections.paragraph: Sıvının görünmesi, rafta aynı görünüm veya kusur sınırını netleştirin. SKU, malzeme, ml, oz, kapak ve baskıyı yazın.

sections.heading: Sabit ışıkta kontrol edin
sections.paragraph: Aynı zemin, ışık yönü ve mesafeyi kullanın. Gövde, omuz, taban, pus, kabarcık ve parçacığı inceleyin.

sections.heading: Kalıp izini taşıma hasarından ayırın
sections.paragraph: Elleçleme öncesi ve sonrası çizik, çapak, hat, nokta ve deformasyonu arayın. Konumu ve koşulu fotoğraflayın.

sections.heading: Kapak, ağız ve tabanı birlikte kontrol edin
sections.paragraph: Kesin SKU'yu monte edin; diş, conta, kapak yüksekliği, taban ve stabiliteyi kontrol edin. Görünüm sızdırmazlık kanıtı değildir.

sections.heading: Baskı ve tutarlılığı inceleyin
sections.paragraph: Kayıt, kenar, opaklık, şeffaf alan ve bilgileri onaylı tasarımla karşılaştırın. Kanıtsız dayanıklılık iddiası yazmayın.

sections.heading: Görünümü ambalajla koruyun
sections.paragraph: Ayırıcı, toz, sürtünme, kapak ve koli içi hareketi kontrol edin. Ambalajlı numuneyi inceleyin.

sections.heading: Tekrar siparişi için standart oluşturun
sections.paragraph: Numune, ışık, kusur, kapak, baskı ve ambalajı saklayın. Reçine, kalıp veya boya değişince yeniden inceleyin.

checklist: SKU'yu ve şeffaf numuneyi kimliğini yazın.
Ml ve yaklaşık oz sınıfını kaydedin.
Malzeme, kapak, renk ve revizyonu belirtin.
şeffaf numuneyi ürününü gerçek numuneyle karşılaştırın.
Tekrarlanabilir kontrol koşulu kullanın.
Veri eksikse yöntem ve kanıt isteyin.
Gözlemi sertifikadan ayırın.
Fotoğraf, belge ve onaylı numuneyi saklayın.
Bileşen değişince yeniden inceleyin.
Kriteri satın alma siparişine ekleyin.
faqs: şeffaf numuneyi fotoğrafı yeterli mi?
Hayır. Fiziksel numune ve tekrarlanabilir koşul kullanın.
Kapasite tüm ölçüleri doğrular mı?
Hayır. SKU için ml, gövde, kapak ve noktaları doğrulayın.
Geniş bir iddia yayınlayabilir miyim?
Yalnızca kaynak kesin ürün, kullanım ve pazarı kapsıyorsa.
Tedarikçi değişirse ne yapmalıyım?
Siparişi durdurun; yapı ve belgeleri yeniden kontrol edin.
